description: Angular component for a sidebar interface in a notes application; handles loading and searching notes, note selection, and creation of new notes.

classes.name: SidebarComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing the sidebar for notes, including loading, searching, selecting, and creating notes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads all notes from the backend service.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query, using backend search or local filter as fallback.

methods.name: onNoteSelect
methods.description: Handles user selecting a note from the list.

methods.name: onCreateNew
methods.description: Triggers creation of a new note.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Refreshes the notes list, reloads notes from backend.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook to load notes when component initializes.
